tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades, and required student records

steps.what: Record observed attendance and obtain examiner-confirmed grades
Check student records and approve the exact destination update
Copy approved attendance, grades, and required fields into the student records system
Reconcile destination records and correct rejected or disputed entries

tasks.design: Configure a native {LMS} export or supported connector to the student records system in {OTHER}. Copy only the teacher-approved version, preserve provenance, and return rejected records for manual correction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved records may be re-entered between distinct teaching and registration systems.
tasks.enabler_now: A supported field mapping can transfer exact values without deciding attendance or grades.
tasks.still_hard: Missing observations, disputed grades, and correct student identity.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher resolves uncertainty and protects students from an incorrect record.
tasks.altitude: Time moves from repeated entry to resolving record discrepancies; assessment authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Radboud requires Brightspace grades also to be published in OSIRIS, documenting a potential double-entry boundary without proving this institution has it.
Exact-value transfer may save labour when teachers currently re-enter approved records; the estimate is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers record maintenance, not marking assessments or making attendance judgements from behaviour. OTHER is the student records system.

Teacher captures student identifier, course identifier, session or assessment identifier, attendance status or confirmed result, result scale, and source version in s1. Examiner-produced confirmed results already exist from assessment work outside this task; that work is unchanged and receives no saving here.

Teacher checks destination identifier, field mapping, update values, and approval version in s2; all capture and approval time remains. Missing mappings, uncertain identities, or unconfirmed results require manual handling.
Test existing native exports and connectors before custom code. If records are already synchronised, no transfer saving applies.
research_questions: Can the supported transfer preserve result scales, amendment history, and student identity without manual re-entry?

already_counted.description: Approve the exact update and reconcile transfer outcomes

incremental.description: Maintain mapping tests and investigate recurring transfer faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact source records, destination records, field mapping, and update values snapshot; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 8 upkeep gives net 17. Range assumes genuine teacher double-entry across systems; already integrated records offer zero saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess the student and select evidence for the requested recommendation
Write the recommendation letter using the teacher's assessment and examples

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's chosen assessment in a first letter draft
loop.output: recommendation letter draft with evidence-linked claims
loop.check: Teacher checks the strength and fairness of each claim, the examples, and recipient-specific requirements
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims are removed or rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed letter template does not express individual evidence and nuanced endorsement

steps.what: Verify, sign, and send the final recommendation letter

tasks.design: In {DOCS}, draft only from the teacher's chosen assessment and observed examples. The teacher verifies the final endorsement and recipient before signing and sending through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Personal recommendations require wording that matches the teacher's actual knowledge.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded prose draft can use a specific evidence brief without choosing the endorsement.
tasks.still_hard: Fair and truthful evaluation of a student whose work is incompletely known.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher takes responsibility for what the endorsement implies.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose work; endorsement decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: A letter draft from teacher-selected evidence may reduce prose work while requiring individual verification; this is an unmeasured E1 design.

assumptions: Boundary includes teacher recommendation work, excluding admissions decisions and student application preparation.

Teacher produces the brief in s1: student name, relationship and duration, observed examples, intended endorsement, permitted disclosures, recipient and purpose. Capture time stays in s1. Insufficient direct evidence requires a manual letter or declining the request.
Test document templates before custom integration; no student-wide ranking or automatic recommendation is introduced.
research_questions: Do generated drafts overstate endorsement or introduce claims absent from the teacher's evidence?

already_counted.description: Verify final claims, sign, and send the letter

incremental.description: Maintain brief instructions and check recurring overstatement

approvals.approved_version: Exact letter text, attachments, student and recipient snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86; gross 14 minus 5 upkeep gives net 9. Range assumes sufficient direct evidence and a conventional letter; unfamiliar students or unusual requests may yield no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Review institutional issues and deliberate with academic or administrative committees

tasks.design: Keep the teacher's committee contribution and deliberation human. Existing papers in {DOCS} support discussion; this scope does not assume the teacher also acts as committee secretary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Institutional decisions require representation and judgement among competing interests.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is proposed for committee membership.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding consequences and reaching an accountable shared decision.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher represents educational experience and challenges weak arguments.
tasks.altitude: Committee responsibilities and decision rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the consequences of a proposed policy

evidence.claim: Committee participation depends on substantive human deliberation; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher committee membership; chair and secretariat tasks are excluded and unchanged.
Committee secretary supplies existing papers before the meeting; no newly structured feed, extraction, or recording is required.
Native document sharing remains sufficient; zero incremental upkeep follows from leaving the process unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the teacher separately holds a secretariat role
research_questions: Which decisions require teacher representation and direct deliberation?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because committee review and deliberation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration, and placement

steps.what: Discuss psychology programmes and answer prospective students' recruitment questions
Help students resolve academic questions during registration
Advise on appropriate student placements and discuss fit or constraints

tasks.design: Retain the teacher's programme discussions, academic registration advice, and placement-fit judgement. Use current requirements in {DOCS}; registration processing and placement administration remain with their existing owners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Students' goals and circumstances do not determine academic suitability by a fixed rule.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automated decision or support process is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Giving fair advice when student aspirations and placement constraints conflict.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher explains the discipline and recognises individual academic support needs.

reach.task: Identify academic constraints before a placement referral

evidence.claim: Teacher participation can centre on academic advice rather than administrative re-entry; no saving is assumed for unchanged conversations.

assumptions: Boundary covers teacher participation, excluding admissions selection, registrar processing, and placement administration. Shares represent a mix of participation activities, not a mandatory sequence for every student.

Programme and placement coordinators maintain existing requirements and availability information; students provide their goals in discussion. No new structured feed or transferred capture work is required.
Existing native document access suffices; unchanged practice requires zero new upkeep.
research_questions: Does this institution assign any repeated administrative entry to teachers beyond academic advice?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Recruitment discussion, registration advice, and placement judgement remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher retains academic and student judgements while checking record transfers and evidence-based letter drafts.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who gives reliable personal advice and maintains accurate student records with less duplicate entry.
